legend: Alice has a very important message M consisting of some non-negative integers that she wants to keep secret from Eve. Alice knows that the only theoretically secure cipher is one-time pad. Alice generates a random key K of the length equal to the message's length. Alice computes the bitwise xor of each element of the message and the key (![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c01d57961927bc12eb51d8197470990daaaa8de.png), where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) denotes the bitwise XOR operation) and stores this encrypted message A. Alice is smart. Be like Alice.
For example, Alice may have wanted to store a message M = (0, 15, 9, 18). She generated a key K = (16, 7, 6, 3). The encrypted message is thus A = (16, 8, 15, 17).
Alice realised that she cannot store the key with the encrypted message. Alice sent her key K to Bob and deleted her own copy. Alice is smart. Really, be like Alice.

Bob realised that the encrypted message is only secure as long as the key is secret. Bob thus randomly permuted the key before storing it. Bob thinks that this way, even if Eve gets both the encrypted message and the key, she will not be able to read the message. Bob is not smart. Don't be like Bob.
In the above example, Bob may have, for instance, selected a permutation (3, 4, 1, 2) and stored the permuted key P = (6, 3, 16, 7).

One year has passed and Alice wants to decrypt her message. Only now Bob has realised that this is impossible. As he has permuted the key randomly, the message is lost forever. Did we mention that Bob isn't smart?

Bob wants to salvage at least some information from the message. Since he is not so smart, he asks for your help. You know the encrypted message A and the permuted key P. What is the lexicographically smallest message that could have resulted in the given encrypted text?

More precisely, for given A and P, find the lexicographically smallest message O, for which there exists a permutation π such that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a13e05dbed3e9a47b9d8d6d0f07297a940549234.png) for every i.
Note that the sequence S is lexicographically smaller than the sequence T, if there is an index i such that Si < Ti and for all j < i the condition Sj = Tj holds.
input: The first line contains a single integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 300000), the length of the message.
The second line contains N integers A1, A2, ..., AN (0 ≤ Ai < 230) representing the encrypted message.
The third line contains N integers P1, P2, ..., PN (0 ≤ Pi < 230) representing the permuted encryption key.
output: Output a single line with N integers, the lexicographically smallest possible message O. Note that all its elements should be non-negative.
note: In the first case, the solution is (10, 3, 28), since ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a896b30a69636d1bfbfa981eae10650f5fee843c.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e383e4333ea37c4652ce2ac1ccfc2cfcf96e0896.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c24ed3c6f88805eb3710487b3fe07ff64034151a.png). Other possible permutations of key yield messages (25, 6, 10), (25, 3, 15), (10, 21, 10), (15, 21, 15) and (15, 6, 28), which are all lexicographically larger than the solution.

legend.ai: 爱丽丝有一条非常重要的消息 M，由一些非负整数组成，她想对 Eve 保密。爱丽丝知道唯一在理论上安全的加密方式是一次性密码本。爱丽丝生成了一个与消息长度相等的随机密钥 K。爱丽丝将消息和密钥中每个元素进行按位异或(![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c01d57961927bc12eb51d8197470990daaaa8de.png)，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 表示按位异或运算)，并存储加密后的消息 A。爱丽丝很聪明。要像爱丽丝一样。
例如，Alice 可能想要存储一条消息 M = (0, 15, 9, 18)。她生成了一个密钥 K = (16, 7, 6, 3)。因此，加密后的消息为 A = (16, 8, 15, 17)。
Alice 意识到，她无法将密钥和加密后的消息存储在一起。于是 Alice 将她的密钥 K 发送给 Bob，并删除了自己手中的副本。Alice 很聪明。真的，要像 Alice 一样。
Bob 意识到，只要密钥是保密的，加密后的消息就是安全的。因此，Bob 在存储密钥之前随机打乱了密钥的顺序。Bob 认为这样一来，即使 Eve 同时获得了加密后的消息和密钥，她也无法读出消息。Bob 不聪明。不要学 Bob。
在上面的例子中，Bob 例如可以选择排列 (3, 4, 1, 2)，并存储打乱顺序后的密钥 P = (6, 3, 16, 7)。
一年过去了，Alice 想要解密她的消息。直到这时 Bob 才意识到这是不可能的。由于他随机打乱了密钥的顺序，这条消息永远丢失了。我们提过 Bob 不聪明吗？
Bob 想从这条消息中至少挽救一些信息。由于他没那么聪明，所以向你求助。你知道加密后的消息 A 和打乱顺序后的密钥 P。对于给定的加密文本，可能得到的消息中字典序最小的是哪一个？
更准确地说，给定 A 和 P，请找出字典序最小的消息 O，使得存在一个排列 π，对于每个 i 都有 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a13e05dbed3e9a47b9d8d6d0f07297a940549234.png)。
注意，如果存在一个下标 i，使得 Si < Ti，且对于所有 j < i 都满足 Sj = Tj，则序列 S 在字典序上小于序列 T。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 N（1 ≤ N ≤ 300000），表示消息的长度。
第二行包含 N 个整数 A1、A2、...、AN（0 ≤ Ai < 230），表示加密后的消息。
第三行包含 N 个整数 P1、P2、...、PN（0 ≤ Pi < 230），表示置换后的加密密钥。

output.ai: 输出一行，包含 N 个整数，即字典序最小的可能消息 O。注意，其所有元素都应为非负数。

note.ai: 在第一种情况下，答案是 (10, 3, 28)，因为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a896b30a69636d1bfbfa981eae10650f5fee843c.png)、![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e383e4333ea37c4652ce2ac1ccfc2cfcf96e0896.png) 和 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c24ed3c6f88805eb3710487b3fe07ff64034151a.png)。密钥的其他可能排列会得到消息 (25, 6, 10)、(25, 3, 15)、(10, 21, 10)、(15, 21, 15) 和 (15, 6, 28)，它们在字典序上都大于该答案。
